intended_scope: Chillers, CRAH or CRAC context, pumps, BMS or DCIM-connected controllers, utility support assets, and workflow-facing operational evidence typical of facilities and data-center operations, while excluding complete building automation or IT configuration-management products.
measurement_signal_expectations: Temperature, humidity, differential pressure, power, and utility measurements should preserve typed unit and quality semantics.
Identity convergence across BMS, CMMS, OEM cloud, and workflow systems should remain time-aware.
event_alarm_expectations: Environmental alarms, communication loss, and maintenance suppressions should remain explicit.
Late-arriving evidence should remain distinguishable from live operational time.
reliability_work_requirements: Facilities maintenance should preserve requested work, verification, and observed outcome separately.
Condition trends should remain linkable to work effectiveness for repeated utility assets.

safety_cyber_applicability.safety_profile_applicability: Applicable for bounded interlock or bypass visibility where utility protection context matters.
safety_cyber_applicability.cyber_profile_applicability: Applicable for BMS, DCIM, controller, and gateway identity and posture context.
notes: The scaffold does not convert SSOM into a building-management product.
Cyber applicability is foundational and does not imply IT asset-management completeness.

servicenow_serving_projection_implicatio: Project facility or data-center operational state, risk, anomalies, and related work references for workflow consumers.
Do not mirror all raw BMS or OEM cloud data as workflow-primary storage.
standards_mapping_applicability: ISA-95 or IEC 62264 where enterprise-control boundaries matter
known_exclusions: Complete DCIM, ITSM, or building-automation application schemas.
Detailed rack, VM, or server software-configuration modeling.
Energy market, billing, or lease-management semantics.

end_to_end_example.scenario_label: Chiller identity convergence and workflow projection
end_to_end_example.narrative_summary: A facility chiller preserves identity continuity across BMS, CMMS, OEM cloud, and ServiceNow-facing workflows while keeping raw evidence and analytics outside workflow-primary storage.

stages.summary: Environmental and utility observations remain typed and normalization-aware.
Operational facility alarms remain separate from workflow tasks or tickets.
Work and verification context can remain linked to utility equipment condition and outcome.
Gateway or controller posture context can be attached through the cyber foundation profile where needed.
A ServiceNow-facing projection exposes current condition, related assets, and evidence freshness.
The example ends with preserved identity continuity and workflow-facing context, not a replacement of the evidence layer.
